finalists.label: Paraganglioma
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive evidence, including a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl and tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin.

finalists.label: Multiple endocrine neoplasia
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by the SDHB gene variant, which is a strong indicator of hereditary paraganglioma-pheochromocytoma syndrome, but the presence of a specific paraganglioma diagnosis makes it a weaker candidate compared to Paraganglioma.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive evidence, including a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl and tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin, which outweighs the evidence for Hereditary paraganglioma-pheochromocytoma syndrome.
